comment: Tracked queries for the receipts engine. target: eam or client:<slug>. brandTerms: strings whose presence counts as a citation — NEVER put a brand term inside the query itself (tautology), and for EAM use only eam-agency (bare EAM collides with other entities, e.g. Eskimoz AI Marketing on ChatGPT, caught 2026-07-28). Add queries freely — npm run geo:probe iterates this list.
